# DnB Santa

> A live Christmas act: Santa arrives with a drum and bass disco in a box. Business Christmas parties, school story visits and community events. Real Santa in person, no AI voices or pictures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dnbsanta.com/): What DnB Santa does and who he is.
- [Book](https://dnbsanta.com/book.html): Booking enquiry form for businesses, schools and events.
